summary: Tests-first revision added local-stub coverage and a red OpenAPI-document contract test. Swift is not installed in this container, and the upstream OpenAPI document has not yet been vendored.

references.result: Upstream #110 is closed, but its main tree did not expose a vendorable OpenAPI JSON artifact at inspection time.
Red test requires the future vendored document and all six client operations.
Operation coverage test written; generated client does not exist in this tests-only revision.
Local-stub adapter test is ready for generated-type wiring in the implementation revision.
Local URLProtocol stubs cover reads and existing write operations; swift test could not start because swift is absent.
Contract deltas and the required PR-description review are recorded for the implementation PR.
